relationships.subject: colitis
relationships.evidence_quote: The mean ± standard deviation (SD) of the neuronal density in CC1 was significantly decreased in rats with colitis compared to the control group

relationships.subject: cingulate cortex
relationships.evidence_quote: Activation of CC has been linked to a reduction in pain-related behavior in animal models

key_findings: Acetic acid colitis in rats reduced neuronal density in cingulate cortex areas 1 and 2 bilaterally; amygdala decrease was not significant.
Authors propose neuroinflammation, BBB disruption and vasculitis as possible mechanisms, not tested.
